ruling_title: CTO ruling on the K1 #700 open decisions
activation_rule: These are decided implementation requirements. Phil decided R6/Q1 and confirmed R7/Q3 on 20 Nov 2026. No product question or provisional product default remains; no alternative is inferred from an input flag.

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: A previously accepted stop/pause remains actor/target-bound and recorded under the original actor with revocation noted. This covers a requester who lost the grant, was disabled or was deleted (CTO confirmation, 22 Nov 2026); the grant loss, disablement or deletion is noted. It only reduces watering; never opens, re-enables or extends. ACK and UI show application.

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: Fresh bootstrap stores admin in both flags. One recorded upgrade promotes only the original enabled bootstrap account if no enabled admin exists, with atomic audit/receipt/revocation and a release-note line. Addendum 22 Nov 2026, applied first: a row 1 (users.id=1) that still has the shipped default password is never promoted, whether enabled or disabled and whatever its username; the next enabled account by account number is promoted instead, and operator recovery applies only if there is none. Otherwise a missing or disabled original uses operator recovery; never promote any other account.

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: Gateway system commands require the enabled paired gateway owner or enabled gateway admin. An unpaired owner is refused with a re-link hint; resource ownership is no fallback (Phil 5c).

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: Every retained prediction setting follows normal enabled writer plus owned/granted-zone permission; remove the prediction owner shortcut. No product exceptions.

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: Revocation uses generation only, never issued-at versus revocation times. A generation mismatch always denies. Expiry uses max(current clock, persisted high-water mark), so rollback cannot extend or revive expiry. Fresh valid local password login for an enabled account succeeds behind the mark, issuing a session with current generation and expiry based on that effective clock.

decisions.authority: Phil decision, 20 Nov 2026, recorded in CTO ruling
decisions.rule: Radio tools and raw radio data are limited to the enabled paired gateway owner and enabled gateway admins over the whole gateway. No installer role or entitlement. Member/viewer membership alone and cloud SUPER_ADMIN never authorize them. Sensor history and device GPS remain separate.

decisions.authority: Phil decision, 20 Nov 2026, recorded in CTO ruling
decisions.rule: Fence cloud sessions immediately. A disconnected gateway accepts local login without an offline time limit until reconnect; edge revocation commits then. Deliver through the gateway own non-human transport credential, unaffected by disabling a human polling principal.

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: Durable link incarnation plus ordered credential revisions; atomically commit link/account/verifier/revocation; identical duplicates no-op, stale/conflicting updates fenced. Transport refresh is separate.

decisions.authority: CTO ruling and lead confirmation, 20 Nov 2026
decisions.rule: Human commands carry the gateway-local UUID behind authority_actor_v1, cloud deployed first. FORCE_EDGE_SYNC/SYNC_LINKED_AUTH carry a bound system actor. Queued pauses keep their recorded actor. Actorless queued commands are refused at upgrade and never assigned to the owner. Preserve protected ACK/mirror settlement.
